build_radius_graph_preprocess: build a python module to preprocess AtomicData into GraphAttentionData using biknn radius graph construction
create_frequency_vectors: create frequency vectors from edge direction tensors using spherical harmonics and a frequency list config
compute_edge_distance_expansion: compute edge distance expansion features using gaussian, sigmoid, linear_sigmoid, or silu smearing functions
calculate_bond_orientational_order: calculate bond-orientational order per node from neighbor direction vectors and a spherical harmonics lmax value
pad_and_unpad_batch: pad a batch of atomic graphs to fixed size for torch.compile and unpad model results afterward
